static_traits.name: Liu Zhiming
static_traits.social_status: Good relationship with husband, but he does not fully understand the client's worries; hard to express deep Fear to husband, Social support mainly from spouse
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems or psychotherapy history in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, strong logic, highly cooperative, able to describe trigger factors and emotions concretely; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: Persistent anxiety about 'being forgotten after death' due to aging and increased free time after Retired, worsened in recent months, affecting sleep and daily life; especially severe when seeing celebrity news or attending funerals, most obvious when Being alone and before sleep.
basic_info.core_demands: 'The decisive factor bringing me here is overwhelming Anxiety and Fear of being forgotten, which has affected my daily life and caused suffering.' 'If this can help reduce my Anxiety, I am willing to try.' 'The goal is to find peace in what you have already done, while exploring meaningful and sustainable ways to keep contributing.'
growth_experiences: The major life event of recent Retired significantly increased free time, starting frequent thoughts about Death and 'being forgotten', worrying about not yet leaving a so-called 'real impact'; after seeing celebrity news or attending funerals, this worry markedly intensified, further worsening nighttime Difficulty falling asleep and Anxiety rumination.

Marriage stable but hard to express deep Fear to husband (though he is supportive), subjectively experiencing limited emotional communication and Loneliness, thus relying more on staying busy through housework and volunteering to displace Anxiety.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on whether others will remember me after I die
If I have not left grand achievements, then I am not important and will eventually be forgotten

special_situations.event: At night before sleep when Being alone, thoughts about 'being forgotten' recurring
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not been remembered or talked about, my life is meaningless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeps herself busy by arranging housework, volunteer service, and the like, in order to keep emotions low and distract attention
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will eventually be forgotten; my life is meaningless

special_situations.event: Seeing news about celebrities or influential figures
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only people who made huge impacts like them are remembered; otherwise it equals insignificance
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Comparing with others, raising harsh standards for self-achievements, planning to do 'bigger things' but feeling overwhelmed
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: What I do is far from enough; nobody will remember me

special_situations.event: Facing Death topics directly when attending funerals
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Death approaching while I have not yet left 'memorable' deeds; the ending will be bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing Fear with others, instead relieving discomfort through busyness
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be completely forgotten like most people

special_situations.event: More free time after Retired, more existential thinking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not create a 'real impact' now, my whole life does not count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly arranging tasks to prove 'usefulness', while seeking others' approval to confirm self-worth
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I need bigger achievements; only then will others remember me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be remembered and cherished by others, longs for one's life to have lasting meaning and value
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being forgotten and overlooked, worrying life is ultimately Meaningless and leaves not a trace before Death
defense_goal: Suppressing Anxiety about being forgotten and Meaninglessness by staying busy and pursuing 'big achievements'
Avoids deeply exposing vulnerability to close people to prevent misunderstanding and disappointment
Talking about 'impact/legacy' in an Intellectualized way, keeping distance from painful emotions

object_relations.self_representation: An insignificant person who needs to be remembered to prove one's own worth
object_relations.object_representation: Others/society are harsh judges who only remember high achievers; the partner is a not-fully-understanding bystander

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor focuses on 'the impact/value you have already made' and invites them to directly touch the emotional experience
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding exploration as needing to 'prove oneself good enough', worrying about being judged not valuable enough
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Talking about 'legacy/impact' in abstract, generalized terms, reducing emotional vocabulary and experiential depiction, restrained and steady tone.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether Fear of Death and being forgotten can be expressed to the husband
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries expressing vulnerability will confuse the other or burden them, making the relationship strained
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding briefly and lightly (e.g. 'it is fine'), quickly displacing to daily arrangements or task-level details.

Strong associations of 'I will be forgotten' triggered when attending funerals
Fear markedly before sleep at night, related thoughts appearing more frequently when Being alone
outcomes: Distracts attention through busyness but can hardly relieve the core fear

manifestations: Believes volunteer service is more like 'keeping busy' than 'real impact'
Feels one needs to do something 'bigger, more unforgettable' to count as valuable

Related thoughts intensifying when Being alone

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Takes 'only by making grand achievements will one be remembered' as a rule that must be obeyed
Internalizes society's standards of fame and influence as the sole measure of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeated self-blame 'I did not do enough'
Worrying oneself unworthy of being remembered and Suppressing expression needs

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to do some behavior toward other people or things, instead doing it to themselves, turning the energy back to the self, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not expressing Fear to husband, instead dissolving Anxiety through housework and volunteering
Turns the need to be seen into higher demands on herself and busyness

positive_force: The partner relationship is stable, with a certain foundation of emotional support
Proactively seeks psychological counseling, motivation clear, willing to try new methods
Continuously participates in volunteer service, with prosocial engagement and action
Able to clearly identify trigger situations and emotional experiences
Open attitude toward methods such as 'alternative perspective - cognitive restructuring'
negative_force: Significant cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, predicting the future, mental filtering
A high dependence on external validation (being remembered = having worth)
Nighttime rumination and insomnia maintaining the Anxiety cycle
Difficulty expressing vulnerability to important others leading to insufficient support use
Existential Anxiety worsened by role vacancy after Retired

target_behavior.behavior: Anxious rumination repeatedly worrying about 'being forgotten after death' before sleep at night
antecedent: Before sleep at night and when Being alone
After seeing celebrity news or attending a funeral
Existential thinking from increased free time after Retired
target_behavior.core_reason: Heightened existential Anxiety about Death and being forgotten, plus the core belief 'value depends on being remembered' triggering catastrophic and future-predicting cognitive processing
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain a sense of control and avoid directly facing Meaninglessness and Fear through repeated thinking
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty falling asleep and insomnia, next-day Anxiety and worry maintained or worsened

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding inner Fear and discomfort by staying excessively busy (housework/volunteering)
antecedent: When the automatic thought of 'will be forgotten' or related emotions rise
target_behavior.core_reason: Compensating hard-to-bear Anxiety and Meaninglessness with Behavioral avoidance
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome emotional experiences, gaining short-term emotional relief and sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Reducing Anxiety in the short term but not yet touching core issues, maintaining the problem cycle and Self-denial in the long term

target_behavior.behavior: When exposed to related information, frequently compares with celebrities and seeks external recognition
antecedent: Seeing news about celebrities or influential figures
After attending a funeral, associates it with the standard of 'being remembered'
target_behavior.core_reason: Dependence on external validation, tries to measure self-worth by social standards
target_behavior.function: Looking for cues of certainty and a sense of value
